svg.title: Two hubs, one record set: temporary targets and overrides from treatments
svg.desc: Two hubs, one record set: temporary targets and overrides from treatments. c1-tt-cancel: 2 of 6 Nocturne readings differ from cgm-remote-monitor; c2-ov-cancel: 0 of 6 Nocturne readings differ from cgm-remote-monitor; c6-tt-same-ms: 0 of 4 Nocturne readings differ from cgm-remote-monitor; c7-ov-backfill: 1 of 4 Nocturne readings differ from cgm-remote-monitor. measured, tools/lab/hub-active-state, run 2026-10-12: cgm-remote-monitor fade2299 (15.0.9), Nocturne 42275c812. Synthetic records; T0 = 2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z.
svg.text: Two hubs, one record set: temporary targets and overrides from treatments
Each panel: the records as written (arrival order, top to bottom); the windows cgm-remote-monitor reported at the query times and
the spans Nocturne stored; then what each hub reports as active at each query time. A red cell marked ≠ is a Nocturne reading
c1-tt-cancel · §5 row 1 — Timed temp target (60 min) followed by a cancel at +20 (careportal shape: duration 0)
c2-ov-cancel · §5 row 2 — Temporary Override (60 min) followed by a stored Temporary Override Cancel at +20
c6-tt-same-ms · §5 row 6 — Two temp targets with the same created_at: 60 min @140 arrives first, 30 min @100
c7-ov-backfill · §12 / LAB item — Two indefinite Temporary Overrides, out of order: the +60 one arrives first, the +0
measured, tools/lab/hub-active-state, run 2026-10-12: cgm-remote-monitor fade2299 (15.0.9), Nocturne 42275c812. Synthetic
